copilot.title: Copilot do Code Brothers
copilot.greeting: Hi! Describe an automation and I will build the workflow graph for you. Try: "when webhook then send whatsapp".
copilot.generated: Here is a workflow I generated from your description. Review it, then insert it into the canvas.
copilot.noMatch: I could not map that to nodes yet. Mention a trigger (webhook, schedule, manual) and an action (whatsapp, email, http, shopify, daraz, instagram, youtube…).
